title.en: Guest house: from listing to the guests who find you
title.af: Gastehuis: van advertensie tot die gaste wat jou vind
title.zu: Indlu yezivakashi: kusukela esikhangisweni kuya ezivakashini ezikutholayo
title.xh: Indlu yeendwendwe: ukusuka kwintengiso ukuya kwiindwendwe ezikufumanayo
title.nso: Ntlo ya baeng: go tloga papatšong go ya go baeng bao ba go hwetšago

en: Open Quick, swipe to [[Adventures]] and tap [[List a trip]]
Swipe the Quick door until it says Adventures. A place to stay starts here too.
af: Maak Quick oop, swiep na [[Adventures]] en tik [[List a trip]]
Swiep die Quick-deur tot dit Adventures sê. 'n Blyplek begin ook hier.
zu: Vula i-Quick, swayipha uye ku-[[Adventures]] bese uthepha [[List a trip]]
Swayipha umnyango we-Quick uze ubone u-Adventures. Indawo yokuhlala iqala lapha nayo.
xh: Vula i-Quick, tyibilikisa uye kwi-[[Adventures]] uze ucofe [[List a trip]]
Tyibilikisa ucango lwe-Quick de lubonise u-Adventures. Indawo yokuhlala iqala apha nayo.
nso: Bula Quick, šutiša go ya go [[Adventures]] o kgotle [[List a trip]]
Šutiša lebati la Quick go fihlela le re Adventures. Lefelo la go dula le thoma mo le lona.

en: Pick [[Place to stay]]
Guest houses, B&Bs, self-catering places, farm stays and camp sites all start here.
af: Kies [[Place to stay]]
Gastehuise, B&B's, selfsorgplekke, plaasverblyf en kampplekke begin almal hier.
zu: Khetha [[Place to stay]]
Izindlu zezivakashi, ama-B&B, izindawo zokuziphekela, ukuhlala epulazini nezindawo zokukhempa konke kuqala lapha.
xh: Khetha [[Place to stay]]
Izindlu zeendwendwe, ii-B&B, iindawo zokuziphekela, ukuhlala efama neendawo zokukhempisha zonke ziqala apha.
nso: Kgetha [[Place to stay]]
Dintlo tša baeng, di-B&B, mafelo a go iphepela, go dula polaseng le mafelo a go hloma ditente ka moka di thoma mo.

en: Say what kind of place: [[Guest house]]
B&B, guest house, self-catering, farm stay or camp site. Something else? Tap [[Another option]] and name it.
af: Sê watter soort plek: [[Guest house]]
B&B, gastehuis, selfsorg, plaasverblyf of kampplek. Iets anders? Tik [[Another option]] en noem dit.
zu: Yisho ukuthi iluhlobo luni lwendawo: [[Guest house]]
I-B&B, indlu yezivakashi, ukuziphekela, ukuhlala epulazini noma indawo yokukhempa. Okunye? Thepha [[Another option]] bese uyiqamba ngegama.
xh: Yitsho ukuba luhlobo luni lwendawo: [[Guest house]]
I-B&B, indlu yeendwendwe, ukuziphekela, ukuhlala efama okanye indawo yokukhempisha. Enye into? Cofa [[Another option]] uze uyibize ngegama.
nso: Bolela gore ke lefelo la mohuta mang: [[Guest house]]
B&B, ntlo ya baeng, go iphepela, go dula polaseng goba lefelo la go hloma ditente. Se sengwe? Kgotla [[Another option]] o se reele leina.

en: Your price per room, per night
Tap a price band, or tap [[Another option]], type your price, for example R950, and tap [[Next]]. You can change it later.
af: Jou prys per kamer, per nag
Tik 'n prysband, of tik [[Another option]], tik jou prys, byvoorbeeld R950, en tik [[Next]]. Jy kan dit later verander.
zu: Intengo yakho ngekamelo, ngobusuku
Thepha ibanga lentengo, noma thepha [[Another option]], ubhale intengo yakho, isibonelo R950, bese uthepha [[Next]]. Ungayishintsha kamuva.
xh: Ixabiso lakho ngegumbi, ngobusuku
Cofa uluhlu lwexabiso, okanye cofa [[Another option]], ubhale ixabiso lakho, umzekelo R950, uze ucofe [[Next]]. Unokulitshintsha kamva.
nso: Theko ya gago ka phapoši, ka bošego
Kgotla legoro la theko, goba kgotla [[Another option]], o ngwale theko ya gago, mohlala R950, ke moka o kgotle [[Next]]. O ka e fetoša ka morago.

en: Pick your town
Quick asks once and this phone remembers it. Not on the list? Tap [[My city is not listed]].
af: Kies jou dorp
Quick vra een keer en hierdie foon onthou dit. Nie op die lys nie? Tik [[My city is not listed]].
zu: Khetha idolobha lakho
I-Quick ibuza kanye futhi lolu cingo luyakhumbula. Alikho ohlwini? Thepha [[My city is not listed]].
xh: Khetha idolophu yakho
I-Quick ibuza kanye kwaye le fowuni iyakhumbula. Ayikho kuluhlu? Cofa [[My city is not listed]].
nso: Kgetha toropo ya gago
Quick e botšiša gatee gomme mogala wo o a gopola. Ga e lenaneong? Kgotla [[My city is not listed]].

en: Tap your area
Guests search by place. Your exact address stays private.
af: Tik jou area
Gaste soek volgens plek. Jou presiese adres bly privaat.
zu: Thepha indawo yakho
Izivakashi zisesha ngendawo. Ikheli lakho eliqondile lihlala liyimfihlo.
xh: Cofa indawo yakho
Iindwendwe zikhangela ngendawo. Idilesi yakho echanekileyo ihlala iyimfihlo.
nso: Kgotla lefelo la gago
Baeng ba nyaka ka lefelo. Aterese ya gago ya nnete e dula e le sephiri.

en: Check it and tap [[Save my listing]]
Your words, your price per room per night and your area are on it. Saving is free: you sign the terms in TrustSquare before it goes live.
af: Gaan dit na en tik [[Save my listing]]
Jou woorde, jou prys per kamer per nag en jou area is daarop. Stoor is gratis: jy teken die bepalings in TrustSquare voordat dit regstreeks gaan.
zu: Kuhlole bese uthepha [[Save my listing]]
Amagama akho, intengo yakho ngekamelo ngobusuku nendawo yakho kukhona. Ukulondoloza kumahhala: usayina imigomo ku-TrustSquare ngaphambi kokuthi kube bukhoma.
xh: Yijonge uze ucofe [[Save my listing]]
Amazwi akho, ixabiso lakho ngegumbi ngobusuku nendawo yakho zikuyo. Ukugcina kusimahla: utyikitya imiqathango kwi-TrustSquare phambi kokuba iphile.
nso: E hlahlobe o kgotle [[Save my listing]]
Mantšu a gago, theko ya gago ka phapoši ka bošego le lefelo la gago di gona. Go boloka ke mahala: o saena mabaka go TrustSquare pele e phela.

en: Saved: open it in TrustSquare
Tap [[Sign the terms and publish]]. Your listing opens in the Seller Hub. We also email you the link.
af: Gestoor: maak dit in TrustSquare oop
Tik [[Sign the terms and publish]]. Jou advertensie maak in die Seller Hub oop. Ons e-pos jou ook die skakel.
zu: Kulondoloziwe: kuvule ku-TrustSquare
Thepha [[Sign the terms and publish]]. Isikhangiso sakho sivuleka ku-Seller Hub. Siphinde sikuthumelele isixhumanisi nge-imeyili.
xh: Igciniwe: yivule kwi-TrustSquare
Cofa [[Sign the terms and publish]]. Intengiso yakho ivuleka kwi-Seller Hub. Sikuthumelela nekhonkco nge-imeyile.
nso: E bolokilwe: e bule go TrustSquare
Kgotla [[Sign the terms and publish]]. Papatšo ya gago e bulega go Seller Hub. Re go romela le kgokagano ka imeile.

en: Your draft waits in the Seller Hub
It says [[Draft — not visible yet]]: nobody can see it. Tap [[Edit]] to finish it.
af: Jou konsep wag in die Seller Hub
Dit sê [[Draft — not visible yet]]: niemand kan dit sien nie. Tik [[Edit]] om dit klaar te maak.
zu: Uhlaka lwakho lulinde ku-Seller Hub
Luthi [[Draft — not visible yet]]: akekho ongalubona. Thepha [[Edit]] ukuze ulugcwalise.
xh: Idrafti yakho ilinde kwi-Seller Hub
Ithi [[Draft — not visible yet]]: akukho mntu unokuyibona. Cofa [[Edit]] ukuze uyigqibe.
nso: Papatšo ya gago ya kakanyo e letile go Seller Hub
E re [[Draft — not visible yet]]: ga go yo a ka e bonago. Kgotla [[Edit]] gore o e fetše.

en: Your Quick answers are already in
The type, [[Guest House]], and your place, Wilderness, George, came across from Quick. Tap [[Add Photo]]: the outside or the view first, then a room.
af: Jou Quick-antwoorde is reeds ingevul
Die soort, [[Guest House]], en jou plek, Wilderness, George, het van Quick oorgekom. Tik [[Add Photo]]: eers die buitekant of die uitsig, dan 'n kamer.
zu: Izimpendulo zakho ze-Quick sezikhona
Uhlobo, [[Guest House]], nendawo yakho, Wilderness, George, kuvela ku-Quick. Thepha [[Add Photo]]: kuqala ingaphandle noma ukubuka, bese kuba yikamelo.
xh: Iimpendulo zakho ze-Quick sele zikhona
Uhlobo, [[Guest House]], nendawo yakho, Wilderness, George, zivela kwi-Quick. Cofa [[Add Photo]]: kuqala ngaphandle okanye imbonakalo, emva koko igumbi.
nso: Dikarabo tša gago tša Quick di šetše di le gona
Mohuta, [[Guest House]], le lefelo la gago, Wilderness, George, di tšwa go Quick. Kgotla [[Add Photo]]: pele ka ntle goba pono, ke moka phapoši.

en: Pick your [[Environment]] and add the details
Guests search by it: bush, mountains, coast, farm and more. Then how many it sleeps and your amenities, like breakfast, WiFi and a braai.
af: Kies jou [[Environment]] en voeg die besonderhede by
Gaste soek daarvolgens: bos, berge, kus, plaas en meer. Dan hoeveel dit slaap en jou geriewe, soos ontbyt, WiFi en 'n braai.
zu: Khetha i-[[Environment]] yakho bese wengeza imininingwane
Izivakashi zisesha ngayo: ihlathi, izintaba, ugu, ipulazi nokunye. Bese kuba ilala abantu abangaki nokunethezeka kwakho, njengesidlo sasekuseni, i-WiFi ne-braai.
xh: Khetha i-[[Environment]] yakho uze wongeze iinkcukacha
Iindwendwe zikhangela ngayo: ihlathi, iintaba, unxweme, ifama nokunye. Emva koko ilala abantu abangaphi kunye nezinto zokonwaba, njengesidlo sakusasa, i-WiFi ne-braai.
nso: Kgetha [[Environment]] ya gago gomme o oketše dintlha
Baeng ba nyaka ka yona: sekgwa, dithaba, lebopo, polasa le tše dingwe. Ke moka gore e robatša batho ba bakae le ditlabelo tša gago, bjalo ka dijo tša mesong, WiFi le braai.

en: Tap [[Save Changes]], then accept the seller terms
Read to the end, tick both boxes and tap [[I accept]]. Your photos and answers are saved.
af: Tik [[Save Changes]], aanvaar dan die verkopersbepalings
Lees tot aan die einde, merk albei blokkies en tik [[I accept]]. Jou foto's en antwoorde word gestoor.
zu: Thepha [[Save Changes]], bese wamukela imigomo yabathengisi
Funda kuze kube sekugcineni, maka womabili amabhokisi bese uthepha [[I accept]]. Izithombe zakho nezimpendulo kuyalondolozwa.
xh: Cofa [[Save Changes]], emva koko wamkele imiqathango yabathengisi
Funda de kube sekupheleni, phawula zombini iibhokisi uze ucofe [[I accept]]. Iifoto zakho neempendulo ziyagcinwa.
nso: Kgotla [[Save Changes]], ke moka o amogele mabaka a barekiši
Bala go fihla mafelelong, swaya mapokisi ka bobedi o kgotle [[I accept]]. Diswantšho tša gago le dikarabo di a bolokwa.

en: Tap [[Publish my listing]]: you are live
Your Seller Hub says [[Live]]. Guests can find you and ask for an introduction straight away.
af: Tik [[Publish my listing]]: jy is regstreeks
Jou Seller Hub sê [[Live]]. Gaste kan jou vind en dadelik vir 'n bekendstelling vra.
zu: Thepha [[Publish my listing]]: usubukhoma
I-Seller Hub yakho ithi [[Live]]. Izivakashi zingakuthola futhi zicele ukwethulwa ngokushesha.
xh: Cofa [[Publish my listing]]: uyaphila
I-Seller Hub yakho ithi [[Live]]. Iindwendwe zinokukufumana kwaye zicele ukwaziswa ngoko nangoko.
nso: Kgotla [[Publish my listing]]: o a phela
Seller Hub ya gago e re [[Live]]. Baeng ba ka go hwetša gomme ba kgopela go tsebišwa gona bjale.

en: A guest opens Adventures and taps [[Stays]]
She sees places to stay only, from guest houses to bush camps.
af: 'n Gas maak Adventures oop en tik [[Stays]]
Sy sien net blyplekke, van gastehuise tot boskampe.
zu: Isivakashi sivula i-Adventures bese sithepha [[Stays]]
Sibona izindawo zokuhlala kuphela, kusukela ezindlini zezivakashi kuya emakamu asehlathini.
xh: Undwendwe luvula i-Adventures luze lucofe [[Stays]]
Lubona iindawo zokuhlala kuphela, ukusuka kwizindlu zeendwendwe ukuya kwiinkampu zasehlathini.
nso: Moeng o bula Adventures gomme o kgotla [[Stays]]
O bona mafelo a go dula feela, go tloga dintlong tša baeng go ya dikampeng tša sekgwa.

en: She picks the surroundings she wants
In [[Filtered Search]], [[Stays]] is already picked. She taps an [[Environment]], like [[Coastal & Beach]], then [[Show results]].
af: Sy kies die omgewing wat sy wil hê
In [[Filtered Search]] is [[Stays]] reeds gekies. Sy tik 'n [[Environment]], soos [[Coastal & Beach]], dan [[Show results]].
zu: Sikhetha indawo esiyifunayo
Ku-[[Filtered Search]], u-[[Stays]] usukhethiwe. Sithepha i-[[Environment]], njenge-[[Coastal & Beach]], bese [[Show results]].
xh: Lukhetha indawo olufuna yona
Kwi-[[Filtered Search]], u-[[Stays]] sele ekhethiwe. Lucofa i-[[Environment]], njenge-[[Coastal & Beach]], emva koko [[Show results]].
nso: O kgetha tikologo yeo a e nyakago
Go [[Filtered Search]], [[Stays]] e šetše e kgethilwe. O kgotla [[Environment]], bjalo ka [[Coastal & Beach]], ke moka [[Show results]].

en: Your stay is there
Your card says [[Stays]], your environment and your price a night. She can also type your town in the search box.
af: Jou verblyf is daar
Jou kaart sê [[Stays]], jou omgewing en jou prys per nag. Sy kan ook jou dorp in die soekblokkie tik.
zu: Indawo yakho ikhona
Ikhadi lakho lithi [[Stays]], okukuzungezile nentengo yakho ngobusuku. Angabhala nedolobha lakho ebhokisini lokusesha.
xh: Indawo yakho ikhona
Ikhadi lakho lithi [[Stays]], okukujikelezileyo nexabiso lakho ngobusuku. Unokubhala nedolophu yakho kwibhokisi yokukhangela.
nso: Lefelo la gago le gona
Karata ya gago e re [[Stays]], tikologo ya gago le theko ya gago ka bošego. A ka ngwala le toropo ya gago lebokoseng la go nyaka.

en: She reads your listing
Your price a night, your area, your environment and your Trust Score. Your name and address stay private.
af: Sy lees jou advertensie
Jou prys per nag, jou area, jou omgewing en jou Trust Score. Jou naam en adres bly privaat.
zu: Sifunda isikhangiso sakho
Intengo yakho ngobusuku, indawo yakho, okukuzungezile ne-Trust Score yakho. Igama lakho nekheli lakho kuhlala kuyimfihlo.
xh: Lufunda intengiso yakho
Ixabiso lakho ngobusuku, indawo yakho, okukujikelezileyo ne-Trust Score yakho. Igama lakho nedilesi yakho zihlala ziyimfihlo.
nso: O bala papatšo ya gago
Theko ya gago ka bošego, lefelo la gago, tikologo ya gago le Trust Score ya gago. Leina la gago le aterese di dula e le sephiri.

en: She asks for an introduction
She taps [[Join queue]] and writes a short question. 1 Tuppence is held from her, and spent only if you accept.
af: Sy vra vir 'n bekendstelling
Sy tik [[Join queue]] en skryf 'n kort vraag. 1 Tuppence word van haar teruggehou en net bestee as jy aanvaar.
zu: Sicela ukwethulwa
Sithepha [[Join queue]] bese sibhala umbuzo omfushane. I-Tuppence e-1 iyabanjwa kuso, isetshenziswe kuphela uma wamukela.
xh: Lucela ukwaziswa
Lucofa [[Join queue]] luze lubhale umbuzo omfutshane. I-Tuppence e-1 iyabanjwa kulo, isetyenziswe kuphela ukuba uyamkela.
nso: O kgopela go tsebišwa
O kgotla [[Join queue]] gomme o ngwala potšišo ye kopana. Tuppence e 1 e swarwa go yena, e šomišwa feela ge o amogela.

en: The first time, she accepts the Terms
Before her first introduction request she reads the TrustSquare Terms once and taps [[I accept the Terms]]. Then her request goes to you.
af: Die eerste keer aanvaar sy die bepalings
Voor haar eerste versoek vir 'n bekendstelling lees sy die TrustSquare-bepalings een keer en tik [[I accept the Terms]]. Dan gaan haar versoek na jou.
zu: Okokuqala, samukela imigomo
Ngaphambi kwesicelo saso sokuqala sokwethulwa sifunda imigomo ye-TrustSquare kanye bese sithepha [[I accept the Terms]]. Bese isicelo saso siza kuwe.
xh: Okokuqala, lwamkela imiqathango
Phambi kwesicelo salo sokuqala sokwaziswa lufunda imiqathango ye-TrustSquare kanye luze lucofe [[I accept the Terms]]. Emva koko isicelo salo siza kuwe.
nso: La mathomo, o amogela mabaka
Pele ga kgopelo ya gagwe ya mathomo ya go tsebišwa o bala mabaka a TrustSquare gatee gomme o kgotla [[I accept the Terms]]. Ke moka kgopelo ya gagwe e tla go wena.

en: Read her question
Open [[My Space]]. Her request and her message wait under Open actions.
af: Lees haar vraag
Maak [[My Space]] oop. Haar versoek en haar boodskap wag onder Open actions.
zu: Funda umbuzo wakhe
Vula [[My Space]]. Isicelo sakhe nomlayezo wakhe kulinde ngaphansi kuka-Open actions.
xh: Funda umbuzo wakhe
Vula [[My Space]]. Isicelo sakhe nomyalezo wakhe zilinde phantsi kwe-Open actions.
nso: Bala potšišo ya gagwe
Bula [[My Space]]. Kgopelo ya gagwe le molaetša wa gagwe di letile ka fase ga Open actions.

en: Accept
Tap [[Accept]]. It costs you nothing. You both get an email: reply to it to talk. Your email address stays private.
af: Aanvaar
Tik [[Accept]]. Dit kos jou niks. Julle albei kry 'n e-pos: antwoord dit om te praat. Jou e-posadres bly privaat.
zu: Yamukela
Thepha [[Accept]]. Akukubizi lutho. Nobabili nithola i-imeyili: yiphendule ukuze nikhulume. Ikheli lakho le-imeyili lihlala liyimfihlo.
xh: Yamkela
Cofa [[Accept]]. Akukuxabisi nto. Nobabini nifumana i-imeyile: yiphendule ukuze nithethe. Idilesi yakho ye-imeyile ihlala iyimfihlo.
nso: Amogela
Kgotla [[Accept]]. Ga go go biditše selo. Ka bobedi le hwetša imeile: e arabe gore le boledišane. Aterese ya gago ya imeile e dula e le sephiri.

en: She sees you accepted
Her [[Intros]] say [[Accepted]], and her 1 Tuppence is spent. After her stay she can tap [[I stayed with them]]: it counts towards your Trust Score.
af: Sy sien jy het aanvaar
Haar [[Intros]] sê [[Accepted]], en haar 1 Tuppence is bestee. Ná haar verblyf kan sy [[I stayed with them]] tik: dit tel vir jou Trust Score.
zu: Sibona ukuthi wamukele
Ama-[[Intros]] aso athi [[Accepted]], futhi i-Tuppence yaso e-1 isisetshenzisiwe. Ngemva kokuhlala kwaso singathepha [[I stayed with them]]: kubalelwa ku-Trust Score yakho.
xh: Lubona ukuba wamkele
Ii-[[Intros]] zalo zithi [[Accepted]], kwaye i-Tuppence yalo e-1 isetyenzisiwe. Emva kokuhlala kwalo lunokucofa [[I stayed with them]]: kubalelwa kwi-Trust Score yakho.
nso: O bona gore o amogetše
Di-[[Intros]] tša gagwe di re [[Accepted]], gomme Tuppence ya gagwe e 1 e šomišitšwe. Ka morago ga go dula ga gagwe a ka kgotla [[I stayed with them]]: e balelwa go Trust Score ya gago.

en: Put your stay on your WhatsApp Status
In your [[Seller Hub]] tap [[Share to Status]]. A card with your stay, your price and your link opens: save it and post it.
af: Sit jou verblyf op jou WhatsApp Status
Tik in jou [[Seller Hub]] op [[Share to Status]]. 'n Kaart met jou verblyf, jou prys en jou skakel maak oop: stoor dit en plaas dit.
zu: Beka indawo yakho ku-WhatsApp Status yakho
Ku-[[Seller Hub]] yakho thepha [[Share to Status]]. Kuvuleka ikhadi elinendawo yakho, intengo yakho nesixhumanisi sakho: lilondoloze bese ulifaka.
xh: Beka indawo yakho kwi-WhatsApp Status yakho
Kwi-[[Seller Hub]] yakho cofa [[Share to Status]]. Kuvuleka ikhadi elinendawo yakho, ixabiso lakho nekhonkco lakho: ligcine uze ulifake.
nso: Bea lefelo la gago go WhatsApp Status ya gago
Go [[Seller Hub]] ya gago kgotla [[Share to Status]]. Karata ye e nago le lefelo la gago, theko ya gago le kgokagano ya gago e a bulega: e boloke gomme o e tsenye.
